sliit.lk: 50. The gap: HSTS.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.

The lesson for every team: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.

hsbc.bm: 75. The gap: measurement.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses.

The lesson for every team: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.
